items.text: [p align="start"]Hey Speedstars,

[p align="start"]Disney Speedstorm’s Season 19 “Villainous Ever After”, inspired by Disney Villains, is almost here, and the team has been working on changes and improvements to the game based on community feedback.
[p align="start"]SEASON 19 CHANGES
[p align="start"]You can also check out the Season 19 changes outlined in our First Look Video.
[p align="start"]NEW RACER PROGRESSION

[p align="start"]We are updating the Racer Progression system. The update replaces the old level system with a clearer Star system, where racers gain small boosts to their Stats every time they are upgraded, and much bigger boosts when they gain a new full Star.

[p align="start"]Existing progress is carrying over, with Racers levels rounded up to full Stars. A new 6th Star is also introduced for even higher stat boosts. Additionally, Upgrade Coins are now replaced by Tune Coins (with old coins converting to max 2,000 Tokens). Racers can now be Supercharged starting at 5 Stars, and can reach the 6th Star independently from Supercharge.
[p align="start"]Please check the following articles for more details.
New Racer Progression explained: [dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/1537830/announcements/detail/492719985750180171"]
FAQ: [dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/1537830/announcements/detail/492719985750180173"]
[p align="start"]ADVENTURE ROAD

[p align="start"]Adventure Road is a brand-new Solo mode focusing on different racer Collections. Similarly to Chapters in the Season Tour, different Collections will now have a set of Challenges with Missions. Race through the Adventures with various Racers, complete Missions and receive special rewards!

[p align="start"]At first, you'll be able to play the Adventures for Mickey and Friends, Lilo & Stitch, Aladdin, Big Hero 6, and Zootopia Collections, and we're planning to add more in the future updates.

[p align="start"]The more races and challenges you complete, the more rewards you'll get! The rewards are all about the Racers featured in the Collection, and will include Racer Shards, Suits, Deluxe Karts, Kart Colors, Avatars, Frames, and more!

[p align="start"]Each of the Collection in the Adventure Road features its own Adventure Pass. Completing Missions from a Collection will grant you Adventure XP of that Collection. The more Adventure XP you collect, the further you progress in the Adventure Pass, and the more rewards you get!
[p align="start"]RETRY RACE

[p align="start"]You can now quickly restart the race you’re playing. The restart button is located in the Pause race menu, and you can use it inside Season map races, event races with bots, and Grand Prix races.
[p align="start"]However, it is not be available during races that have a cost of entry, and races with a
limited number of tries.
[p align="start"]RACER BOOST
[p align="start"]Racers Judy Hopps, Nick Wilde, Flash, and Kuzco will now be available to select.
[p align="start"]NEW SUPERCHARGE RACERS

[p align="start"]Jasmine from Disney’s Aladdin, Disgust, Joy and Ennui from Disney and Pixar’s Inside Out, Olaf from Disney’s Frozen, and Baloo from Disney’s The Jungle Book will be available to select.
[p align="start"]SEASON 19 TOURNAMENT AND VAULT PASS
[p align="start"]During Season 19, Tournaments and Vault Passes will become available for Disney’s Alice in Wonderland.
[p align="start"]Tournaments will be available for all 3 Racers: Alice, Mad Hatter and Queen of Hearts.
[p align="start"]GENERAL FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS
Simplified the flow of getting Duplicate Items exchanged to Season Coins.
Fixed small visual and audio issues.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]RACER BALANCING
[p align="start"]YHere’s a breakdown of the Racer Balancing improvements coming to the game at the start of Season 19.
[p align="start"]RACER BALANCING - BUFFS

[p align="start"]RACERS ALADDIN, AURORA, SERGEANT CALHOUN, ENNUI, GOOFY, LILO, MAD HATTER, MALEFICENT, MAUI, MOANA, MRS. INCREDIBLE, OSWALD, PRINCE ERIC, QUEEN OF HEARTS, RUSSELL, SCROOGE MCDUCK, SNOW WHITE, TIGGER, MATER

Autopilot now scales with the Racer’s Top Speed stat, including bonuses from Crew Members. This results in an overall buff to all Racers with Autopilot skills - the higher a Racer’s Top Speed, the faster they move while Autopilot is active. Autopilot speed depends on the Top Speed stat before the start of the race, and is not dynamically affected by in-race speed boosts or slowdowns.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]That’s it for all the changes coming to Season 19. These will go live alongside the launch of the season on April 9.

items.text: Hey Speedstars,
Disney Speedstorm’s Season 14, inspired by Disney and Pixar’s Toy Story, is approaching fast, and the team has been working on changes and improvements to the game based on community feedback.
SEASON 14 CHANGES
You can also check out the Season 14 changes outlined in our First Look video.
Tales
Tales is a new event format that brings together multiple Limited Events into one evolving experience — with both PvE and PvP challenges, and major rewards up for grabs.
New Limited Events unlock progressively throughout each Tale, with each one featuring its own set of quests and objectives.
Some Limited Events can be grinded endlessly, while others have fixed limit.
Every point you earn contributes to a global reward track. Progress through Milestones and unlock exclusive prizes as the Tale unfolds.

Each Tale includes a grand leaderboard that tracks your total score across all connected Limited Events in the chain. Your combined points from participating TLEs will determine your overall rank. The higher you place when the Tale ends, the better your final reward.
Multiple Tales can run at once — so there’s always a new challenge, and more chances to climb the ranks.
MULTIPLAYER & ECONOMY EVENTS
We’re also introducing a New Type of Time-Limited Event!

This new type of event features new objectives, where players can enjoy competing against the other players, and earn great rewards for achieving the highest scores. Here are the elements that define these events:
The New Objectives will be actions that are tied to the main gameplay (e.g. participate in multiplayer races.)
Players will be given unlimited tries to score as many points as possible.
The new type of Time Limited Events will have certain milestones that will give rewards.
RAMP STUNTS INSTANT REACTION
We’ve updated how stunts work— giving you more control, more reward, and more chances to leave your rivals in the dust.
Performing aerial stunts after launching off a ramp no longer just gives a speed boost when landing.
Now, each stunt charges your Nitro bar, letting you decide when to unleash your speed.
The more stunts you pull off in a jump, the more Nitro you build — and Tricksters earn even more per stunt.
It’s no longer just about landing with style — it’s about using your airtime strategically to power up.
RACER VOICEOVER
This season, Zurg, Forky, Lotso, and both mid-season Racers — Chip 'n' Dale — will receive voice lines in-game.
NEW SUPERCHARGE RACERS
Hercules from Disney’s Hercules, Elsa from Disney’s Frozen, EVE from Disney and Pixar’s WALL·E, Stitch from Disney’s Lilo & Stitch, and the one and only Goofy, straight from Mickey & Friends.
This season, Buzz Lightyear and Bo Peep from Disney and Pixar’s Toy Story will be available as the two free characters for all players as a Season Tour reward.\
SEASON 14 TOURNAMENT AND VAULT PASS
During Season 14, Tournaments and Vault Passes will become available for both Disney Tim Burton’s The Nightmare Before Christmas and Disney’s Beauty and the Beast.
Tournaments will be available for the following Racers: Jack Skellington, Sally, Dr. Finkelstein, Belle, Beast, and Gaston.
Starting with this season’s update, players on Nintendo Switch 2 can look forward to a much smoother, sharper racing experience thanks to performance enhancements exclusive to the new hardware:
The FPS cap has been raised to 60, delivering buttery-smooth racing compared to the previous 30 FPS limit.
Enjoy 1080p in handheld mode and up to 1440p when docked for a crisper, more detailed look.
A number of other visual improvements such as better shadows, anti-aliasing, and shader quality to bring even more visual polish to every track.
These upgrades are exclusive to Nintendo Switch 2 players, so make sure your game is updated to get the most out of what the new console has to offer.
GENERAL FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS
We’ve been hard at work implementing improvements to enhance your day-to-day experience, including:
Max Racer Level is now displayed in Multiplayer Rankings

Racers above the cap will be adjusted for the race, but crew bonuses and supercharge abilities remain active.
Level caps are visible in menus and post-race screens.
If players from multiple leagues are matched together, the lowest league cap applies.

notes.title: Here’s what you need to know

items.text: You can unlock it at Player Rank 5.
The Calendars can vary in length depending on the occasion. If a Calendar is longer than 7 days, each additional 7th day (usually Sunday) will act as a Milestone, which provides a bonus.

If you miss a day in a Calendar, you will be allowed to progress through the rest of the Calendar. However, you will lose your Login Streak. Skipped Rewards cannot be claimed in some Calendars, but there may be options to purchase it.
Claiming all daily rewards, ensures unlocking the special milestone reward on the 7th day.
You cannot have more than one Calendar available at the same time.
Some Calendars might have some conditions: you might need to have a certain Player Rank or Collection Level in order to see them.
The Daily Reward refresh time is the same for every player.

items.text: Hey SpeedStars,
Disney Speedstorm’s Season 11, inspired by Disney and Pixar’s The Incredibles, is approaching fast, and the team has been working on changes and improvements to the game based on community feedback.
SEASONS AND GOLDEN PASS UPDATE
A reminder to read about the upcoming changes to the length of some seasons and Golden Passes outlined in our previous Community Pit Stop [LINK TO PREVIOUS PIT STOP] if you haven’t already.
INBOX

Players will now find a new tab in the player profile menu called “Inbox”. Starting during Season 11, players will find communications about different topics here, such as in-game Time-Limited Events, Community Pit Stops, maintenances, community activations etc.
This is just the first iteration of this feature, and we will develop it further based on community feedback.
TREASURE RUSH

To celebrate the holiday period, players will be able to participate in additional holiday-themed Treasure Rush Time Limited Events (TLEs). These TLE’s will be in addition to the regular Daily Challenge Treasure Rush TLE currently in-game.

Players will be tasked with collecting some festive-themed items rather than coins. There will not be any limit on Tries and as a result, players will only receive rewards from completing the TLE’s Objectives.
• A “Racer Class” filter has been added to the Racer select menu.
SHOP

• Players can now instantly “Tier Up” or Max out a Racer via dedicated Shop offers.

items.text: Hey SpeedStars,

Disney Speedstorm’s Season 10, inspired by Disney Tim Burton’s The Nightmare Before Christmas, is approaching fast, and the team has been working on changes and improvements to the game based on community feedback.

Starting in Season 10, a pity system will be active for various boxes in Disney Speedstorm. A pity system essentially guarantees that a player will earn one of the highest value items in a box after opening a set number of boxes.

You can still earn one of those items opening less boxes if you are lucky of course, but this system will guarantee that you will pull one of the highest value items eventually. You will be able to see how many more of a certain box you need to open before the pity system comes into effect before opening any particular box.
The pity system will apply to a select number of boxes in the game initially, with a different number of box openings required for the pity system to come into effect depending on the box.

Golden Pass XP will now be earned exclusively from completing Daily and Season Missions. Completing Race Goals to earn Medals in the Season Tour Chapters will still unlock additional Race Nodes and Reward Nodes as usual but will no longer earn XP towards Golden Pass progress.
Completing Race Goals will now grant Season Coins instead of XP.
Previously, the Season Tour chapters contained both a main path and side paths. The side paths typically had higher requirements that players could complete to earn additional rewards.

Starting in Season 10, these side paths will no longer appear in each chapter. They will instead be consolidated into a single additional chapter that will be available from the beginning of the season.

A new feature coming to the Season Tour in Season 10 is the introduction of Arbee Challenge Nodes. Once a player has reached Player Rank 25, certain race nodes in the regular Season Tour chapters will become Arbee Challenge Nodes.

Arbee Challenge Nodes will have an extra, more challenging Race Goal with higher level requirements to complete in addition to the usual 3 Race Goals. Players can choose to toggle this feature on or off at any time.
Completing this additional Arbee Challenge Goal will earn players extra progress towards Arbee Challenge Milestones, an additional reward track for players to earn some great in-game items.
Regulated Multiplayer will now be found within the Limited Events menu. Regulated Multiplayer events will still be regulated to Racer Level 30.
Players will still have unlimited Tries and the rewards will remain unchanged.
Racers can no longer pick up more than 2 Unique Skills in a row.
• Brawler, Defender and Trickster Class Racers will no longer pick up Common Skills Boost or Rush when in first position.
• Speedster Class Racers will no longer be able to pick up more than one of Common Skills Boost or Rush in a row when in first position.
• All Racer Classes will no longer pick up Common Skills Fire, Shield, Bomb or Cloak when in last position.
NITRO FUEL BOTTLES
Currently, only Racers who are within a certain distance of the player in front of them and following their path benefit from the slipstream bonus which fill their Manual Boost Bar.

Starting in Season 10, any Racer that is not actively granting a slipstream bonus because there are no rival Racers in close enough proximity to them for a period of 5 seconds, will start to spawn Nitro Fuel bottles directly behind them on the track every few seconds.

Any other rival player can pick up these Nitro Fuel bottles which will fill their Manual Boost Bar, helping them to catch up to those in front of them. Nitro Fuel bottles cannot be seen or picked up by the Racer who spawned them nor can they be picked up by teammates in Team Mode races.
Starting in Season 10, players can now earn a Win Streak bonus for finishing in the podium places in multiple Ranked Multiplayer races in a row.
As you increase your Win streak counter, you will receive additional MPR points each race, up to a max of 5.
Your Win Streak counter will increase via one of the following methods:
• When you finish in the Top 3 of a Solo Mode Ranked Multiplayer race.
• When your team wins a Team Mode Ranked Multiplayer race.
Your Win Streak counter will reset if one of the following happens:
• When you finish 4th place or lower in a Solo Mode Ranked Multiplayer race.
• When your team loses a Team Mode Ranked Multiplayer race.

If a player loses their Win Streak, they will have the option to use a small number of Tokens to maintain their current Win Streak. The number of Tokens required is dependent on the length of their current Win Streak.
Players in a party will now be able to use a small number of party messages while in the matchmaking menu.

• Offers for “Maxed” Racers and Crew will no longer appear in the Daily Specials tab.

The following changes are being made to Racers’ Unique Skills:

• The duration of the Charged activation has been reduced by 1 second per each Skill level (up to 4 seconds).
• The lifetime of each projectile has been reduced by 30% during the Charged activation.
• The speed of the projectiles blasted backwards or sideways during the Charged activation has been slightly reduced.
• The amount of Manual Boost fuel gained during both Normal and Charged activations has been increased for each Skill level.

We’ve noticed that players have signaled issues with racing against CPU Racers, and we are making the following changes to address this:

Update 3 will introduce an additional control feature to the game – Arbee Drive. With Arbee Drive, the steering and acceleration are controlled by the AI of the game while the player chooses which route to take on the track. All other actions, such as boosting, dashing or using a Skill, remain under the player’s control.
You will be able to toggle Arbee Drive on or off before the start of a race, in the mid-race pause menu, or from the controls settings.

Starting from this update, all players will have a unique username in the game. On PC and consoles, the default username will be the one of the platform. If your PC or console username is Arbee123, it will default to Arbee123 in-game as well.

items.text: Hey SpeedStars!

It’s just one week until Disney Speedstorm’s third season “ʻOhana” inspired by Disney’s Lilo & Stitch touches down! Before you get set to rocket to the racetrack with Lilo, Stitch, Jumba, Captain Gantu and Angel, we wanted to give you a heads up on some of the additional improvements and fixes coming to the game alongside Season 3.

Thanks to everyone in the Community for providing invaluable feedback on our official Discord and social channels to help us take Disney Speedstorm to the next level! Check out all the updates we are making to the Starter Circuit, Teleport Skill, Menus/UI, Private Track and more below.
These updates will go live alongside Season 3 on August 1.

We are revamping the Starter Circuit to improve the onboarding experience for new players. The new Starter Circuit has been streamlined while also introducing and explaining new game features to new players more gradually.
• The Starter Circuit will now have 3 Chapters. (previously 6 Chapters)

We collected lots of feedback on challenges the Teleport Skill was causing in Ranked Multiplayer races in particular. We are making the below changes as a first step towards adjusting the skill.
• The probability of picking up Teleport is being decreased in general.
• The distance from 1st at which Teleport starts to be picked up will be increased.
• The distance a Racer is teleported when closer to 1st position will be decreased.
• The distance a Racer is teleported when further from 1st position will be increased.

• Players will now be able to select any Racer currently playable in the game in Private Track, even if they do not have them unlocked. Mid-season Racers will become available for selection in both Private Track & Local Freeplay once their respective Time Limited Events have concluded.

We are now separating the Singleplayer and Multiplayer game modes into their own dedicated menus.

• The Starter Circuit will move to the Settings menu once completed or if already completed.
• This menu will contain the Ranked Multiplayer, Regulated Multiplayer, Private Track & Local Freeplay game modes.

• Performance when accessing the shop should now be improved on certain platforms.
• New season’s Collections will no longer appear hidden when a new season starts.
• PS+ Rewards will no longer appear as locked when linking multiple accounts.

releases.displayName: Disney Speedstorm Community Pit Stop – Ranked Multiplayer Update

items.text: Hey SpeedStars!
We’ve got a short but sweet Community Pit Stop for you today!

Today we’re focusing solely on some improvements we’ve made to the Ranked Multiplayer progression and score system. We’re always listening to feedback from the Community and want to acknowledge challenges players have experienced when progressing up the leagues. Thanks to your responses we have made some adjustments to address this as much as possible.
These changes will come into effect later this week.

Before diving into the changes, we’d like to take this opportunity to remind players that the CPU Racers are completely excluded when calculating the score distribution at the end of races in Ranked or Regulated Multiplayer. CPU Racers are indicated by an Arbee icon next to their in-game username.

Players will now earn more score points per race on average across all leagues. We have increased the number of points earned for performing well while simultaneously reducing the number of score points lost when finishing in lower positions. Losing score points when finishing in lower positions has been completely removed from the lower leagues as detailed below.

Players will no longer lose any score points in the Bronze, Silver & Gold leagues, regardless of which position they finish in. As long as you complete the race, you will receive some score points to help you progress more easily in the lower leagues. This change will allow players to reach the Platinum league, easier and faster.

Starting in Platinum league and above, players will still lose score points for finishing in lower positions, but the amount lost has been reduced. The number of score points you earn for finishing in higher positions has also been increased, particularly in the highest leagues.
It gets progressively more challenging as you progress through the higher leagues, but you should see a significant improvement in your progress speed if you maintain a positive win ratio.

That’s everything in this edition of the Community Pit Stop! These changes should result in less twists and turns on the road to Ultimate Champion so hop back into Ranked Multiplayer to claim those bragging rights!

releases.displayName: Disney Speedstorm Dev Diary – Racing Visuals Update

items.text: We received a lot of feedback during our PC Closed Beta on how various visual and HUD (Heads Up Display) elements could be improved. In today’s Dev Diary, we will showcase several of the visual changes that are in the works for Disney Speedstorm. Please keep in mind, some of the visuals we showcase in the Dev Diary may change slightly between now and when the game launches, but we’d like to give you an early look at what we’ve been working on.
There’s been a big focus on making improvements to both the visuals and HUD, to give players an overall more immersive and accessible experience.

The above GIF showcases the same pre-race animation that you know and love from the Closed Beta, but with one key improvement. AI Racers will now always be sporting different kart liveries and parts rather than the default set up, so now you’ll be able to view different cosmetic items in action on the track before you may have unlocked them yourself!

The post-race animation has also been given an upgrade with the top three racers now being showcased on-screen at once. You’ll also be able to brag about your place on the podium with your Victory Animation of choice. Check those out in this video if you missed it previously.

In the above GIF you can catch a glimpse of the new and improved Skill Boxes that you can crash through to pick up your racer’s unique and common skills. We feel they are super pretty [Arbee! Do we really have to write that?]

Racer Billboards are also a new addition to the mid-race visuals in Ranked Multiplayer that will provide you with some key information about your rival racers. As long as you are within a certain distance of a rival racer, a billboard will be shown containing their username, current race position, game platform as well as their player avatar. We are still working on the exact design but don’t worry, your Racer Billboard won’t show when using skills that make you invisible like Cloak!
In case you missed it in our last Dev Diary on drifting, we have also improved the visual indicators of when your Drift Boost is ready to activate. Read more about it here.

The Manual Boost Bar is also receiving an upgrade, in order to make it more impactful and visually appealing. Another small change from the Closed Beta will be that when you have your racer’s Unique Skill available, it’s now much more clearly visible in the HUD thanks to some cool new artwork.

There you have it! Just some of the small but important improvements we have made to the race experience for launch. We can’t wait for you to see the final versions and what else we have in store in upcoming Dev Diaries.
